messages:
Sam K: Heliogen follow-up: theyre asking about edgecases for replacing CompetitorY. Main asks: streaming parity, function-calling behavior, and content-filtering divergences. Can we scope a POC focused on these 3 axes?
Mei L: Good call. We should make the POC 10 business days: 5 dev/test + 5 monitoring + fixes. We need to prove streaming chunk boundaries and deterministic function outputs.
Sam K: Buyer wants a sample adapter so their infra team can flip a flag and point to Redwood without reworking SDKs.
Diego O: Ops note: streaming differences are usually about chunk granularity + trailing newlines. We can add a compatibility mode that buffers to n bytes or emits line-delimited frames. Ops prefers 1-2 dev days to expose that as a flag on the gateway.
Mei L: Function calling is trickier. CompetitorY always returns a `tool_call` object with `name` and `args` JSON-string. Redwood returns structured `function_call` with parsed args. We'll need adapter behavior to optionally keep args stringified to match their client parsing.
Jonah R: Security QA: function-call args might contain PII; we must ensure logs respect redaction policy. If adapter re-serializes strings, ensure we don't bypass KMS/HSM policies. Also check outbound webhook signing for any third-party tool calls.
Mei L: Example adapter behavior (pseudo):
```
# adapter mode = compat_y
incoming: {"input": "...") , "templates": [...]} 
translate -> {"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"..."}], "stream_mode": "chunked"}
on_func_call -> {"choice": {"text":"..."}} OR {"function_call": {"name":"send_email","args":"{\"to\":\"x@x.com\"}"}}
```
Mei L: For stream parity: propose two knobs: frame_size (bytes) and emit_complete_event (true/false). The buyer can tune to match their existing client.
Sam K: Pricing Q from their CFO: competitor embeds per-request overhead into committed spend. They need an apples-to-apples per-API-call delta. Can sales provide: per-100k tokens + per-1k function calls (if any) + optional dedicated pool premium?
Diego O: We bill tokens + some fixed request overhead for high frequency function calls due to router CPU. Suggest: estimate per-100k tokens and per-10k calls scenario. I'll draft numbers.
Jonah R: Legal Bot: NDA and Data Processing Addendum required. Also ask them if they need EU data to stay in EU region. If yes, we need region-specific routing.
Legal Bot: Note: For SOC2 / PCI asks, we'll provide redacted reports. On audit logs: we can provide per-tenant logs for 90 days by default, longer by add-on.
QA Bot: Add automated comparator: run streaming and non-streaming prompts through CompetitorY and Redwood; compare token sequence alignment and function_call arg equality. Produce a nightly report with: alignment_rate, function_arg_match_pct, mean_chunk_diff.
Mei L: Dev estimate: adapter shim v1 = 4 dev days (gateway flag + mapping), 2 QA days, 1 day for streaming regression harness. If we need to preserve exact whitespace/newline sequences, additional 1 day.
Sam K: Can we offer them 10k free function calls + 2M tokens for the POC? I can approve up to 5k function calls and 1.5M tokens. Anything above needs revenue signoff.
Diego O: Ops caveat: if they enable dedicated ephemeral pool latency target p95 <150ms we need to reserve capacity. That impacts cost.
Mei L: Action items:
- Sam: confirm approved token/call allowance with buyer (today).
- Mei: open `compat-adapter` PR and include streaming knobs (EOD + link here).
- Diego: draft cost delta scenarios (tokens only, tokens+calls, dedicated premium) (tomorrow).
- Jonah: prep redacted compliance packet and checklist for region needs (tomorrow).
- QA Bot: create nightly comparator job and initial baseline report (48h).
Sam K: I'll run the buyer call at 2pm PT, get their canonical prompt list and their function schema. Will paste here after the sync. :phone:
Mei L: Thanks all. I'll try to reuse the internal `compat-gateway` module; will post PR link when available.
QA Bot: Reminder: store raw competitor outputs in a locked S3 bucket with access logs for auditability.
Sam K: Closing loop after the 2pm call.
